notes: The ASV recasts καθὼς εὐπορεῖτό τις as every man according to his ability: ἕκαστος takes every man, εὐπορεῖτο the noun ability, and τις is left unrepresented. Giving every man to τις and leaving ἕκαστος empty remains defensible.
εἰς left unrepresented because relief compresses the whole phrase (rule 36); the printed gloss Greek for ministry corroborates it.
τοῖς precedes its head noun ἀδελφοῖς, so it takes the determiner with its case preposition and the participle keeps the relativizer (rules 21 and 31).
